description: Implementation of DebugEGLImageTracker classes for tracking EGL image objects, including a no-op and an active tracker with creation/destruction counting and dump functionality.

classes.name: DebugEGLImageTrackerNoOp
classes.description: A no-operation implementation of DebugEGLImageTracker that does nothing on create, destroy, and dump.

classes.name: DebugEGLImageTrackerImpl
classes.description: Active implementation of DebugEGLImageTracker that tracks creation and destruction counts of EGL images, with dump functionality.

methods.name: DebugEGLImageTracker::getInstance
methods.description: Returns a singleton instance of DebugEGLImageTracker, either active or no-op based on a system property.

methods.name: DebugEGLImageTrackerImpl::create
methods.description: Records the creation of an EGL image from a source.

methods.name: DebugEGLImageTrackerImpl::destroy
methods.description: Records the destruction of an EGL image from a source.

methods.name: DebugEGLImageTrackerImpl::dump
methods.description: Outputs current tracking statistics and counts of EGL images.
